fields.title: 📖 Ḥasbunā Allah wa niʿma al-Wakīl
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās** said:

> ***“Ḥasbunā Allah wa niʿma al-Wakīl was said by Ibrāhīm عليه السلام when he was cast into the fire; and Muḥammad ﷺ said it when it was said to him: The people have gathered against you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **Tawakkul** appears when the heart does not break in distress, but binds itself to **Allah**. Whoever takes Allah as the ***best Trustee*** does not stand alone — even when the people gather against him.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb at-Tafsīr, Tafsīr Sūrat Āl ʿImrān, Hadith Nr. 4563.
